text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q4 operating earnings, excluding capital gains, were $1.10 a share vs $0.93 a year ago.
Q4 combined ratio for mortgage insurance was 62.1 pct vs 62.6 pct a year ago. Full year combined ratio for the mortgage insurance business was 60.3 percent vs 63.4 pct in 1995.
Q4 combined ratio for title insurance business was 96.0 pct vs 94.7 pct a year ago. Full year combined ratio was 93.5 pct vs 95.4 pct in 1995.
Q4 overall net premiums written were $128.5 million vs $85.2 million a year ago.
Full year net premiums written were $403.0 million vs $314.0 million a year ago.
Q4 mortgage insurance net premiums written were $113.1 million vs $74.2 million a year ago. Full year mortgage insurance net premiums written were $349.8 million vs $273.7 million a year ago.
Q4 title insurance net premiums written were $15.4 million vs $11.0 million a year ago. Full year title insurance net premiums written were $53.2 million vs $40.3 million a year ago.
